gap_answer: After Philips I took a deliberate two-month break — got married, travelled, reset. Then I took a freelance architecture engagement with Growlogic, designing and delivering their full Azure AKS microservices platform for their AI SaaS product. After that engagement ended, I spent a year building three production software products independently — going deep on LLM engineering, multi-agent systems, and full product ownership from architecture to deployment. Now with family settled and a year of intensive AI engineering behind me, I'm ready to bring all of that into a senior role at scale.
